subject: Crescent3b elevated timeouts — customer communications & recovery updates
messages:
From: Horizon Ops <ops@horizon-analytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden spike in 5xx for Crescent3b on our org

Hi Rafael,

We started seeing a sudden increase in 5xx responses and timeouts from the Crescent3b model for several of our production endpoints around 16:30 PST. Error rates jumped from ~0.2% to ~7% and some calls are returning 504 after 10s. This is impacting our recommendation API and causing retries.

Sample request ids: rq_7a3f..., rq_7d9b..., rq_800c... (we can share full logs).

Can you confirm if there is a known issue? We're prepared to fail over to another model if you recommend one.

Thanks,
— Priya Khatri
Platform Ops | Horizon Analytics
ops@horizon-analytics.com

(Attachment: horizon-sample-errors-20261205.txt)

Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 17:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in 5xx for Crescent3b on our org

Hi Priya — thanks for the quick heads-up and for the sample IDs. We're investigating now.

Immediate notes:
- I'm opening an incident (INC-2026-412) and looping infra/serving.
- Ben & Soojin will triage whether this is a model-serving regression, config/slot saturation, or networking.
- If needed, we can recommend a warm fallback model for the recommendation endpoint to reduce errors while we stabilize.

Proposed immediate step for you: temporarily route a small percentage of requests to 'Crescent3b-v2-compatible' (we'll confirm exact identifier) if your rollout can do that — otherwise we will keep you updated on mitigation steps.

I'll follow up with a technical update in ~30–45 minutes.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll prioritize this.

Best,
Rafael Mendes

rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden spike in 5xx for Crescent3b on our org

Rafael / team — triage notes:
- Observed elevated 5xx starting ~16:25 PST correlating with an increased tail in KV cache invalidations for Crescent3b (multi-tenant pool).
- Root cause (prelim): a background weights-sync job overlapped with a burst of long-context requests, causing increased memory churn and partial OOMs on a subset of serving nodes. Those nodes briefly returned 502/504.
- Mitigation applied (18:12 PST): quarantined affected nodes, rebalanced traffic, increased per-instance cache eviction threshold to avoid repeated full-KV reloads.
- Current status (18:20 PST): error rate dropped to ~0.6% and latency medians are back to normal; tails improving.

Next steps:
1) Run a health check against all Crescent3b pools and keep quarantine until full verification.
2) Patch weights-sync to prevent simultaneous large reloads (will ship a short fix today).
3) Share detailed logs & metrics with Horizon.

I'll prepare a postmortem draft and attach metrics.

— Soojin
Staff SWE, Serving Runtime
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
(Attachments: crescent3b-node-log-summaries-20261205.txt)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Khatri <ops@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Customer update: Crescent3b elevated errors — mitigation & next steps

Hi Priya — quick update from our side and next steps.

What happened (short):
- Between ~16:25–17:50 PST on Dec 5 we observed an elevated rate of 5xx (502/504) for Crescent3b tied to a combination of a scheduled weights-sync and a coincident burst of long-context inference requests. The combination increased memory churn and led to transient service failures on a subset of nodes.

What we did:
- Identified and quarantined affected nodes and rebalanced traffic to healthy pools.
- Adjusted cache eviction thresholds to reduce full KV reloads.
- Deployed a short-term process guard to prevent concurrent large weights-sync on multi-tenant pools.

Current status:
- As of 08:45 PST on Dec 6, error rates are back to baseline (~0.3%). We continue to monitor.

Customer impact:
- Horizon experienced increased 5xx and some 10s+ timeouts during the window. We estimate ~1.2k requests impacted for your org. We can provide request-level error logs if helpful.

Recommended mitigations for Horizon (options):
1) If you require maximum stability during our remediation window, we recommend routing traffic to Crescent3b-fallback (quantized variant) — we can assist with traffic split configuration.
2) Implement client-side short retry with jitter up to 2 retries to smooth transient errors (we can share sample retry code).

Attachments & links:
- Attached: crescent3b-aggregate-5xx-logs-20261205.zip (sanitized request ids and error snippets).
- Incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-412
- Draft postmortem (internal): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1Crescent3b-Incident-Postmortem

Planned follow-up:
- We will publish a customer-facing postmortem by EOD Dec 7 with timeline, root cause, and permanent mitigation.
- I'll loop in eng lead Marcus Lin for the detailed fix schedule.

Apologies again for the disruption — please let me know if you'd like an on-call bridge.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
(Attachments: crescent3b-aggregate-5xx-logs-20261205.zip, crescent3b-latency-heatmap-20261206.png)
